faqs.q: Will every page of my PDF become its own JPG?
faqs.a: Yes. By default each page is exported as a separate JPG file numbered in document order; you can also select a single page to convert on its own.

faqs.q: Does conversion reduce legibility of text?
faqs.a: No. Pages render at the resolution you choose, keeping text and graphics crisp and legible across the exported JPG images.

faqs.q: Is the PDF to JPG tool safe for confidential documents?
faqs.a: Yes. All rendering happens locally in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to any server, and no watermark or account is involved.

faqs.q: Can I control the resolution of the exported images?
